identity.route: subcutaneous/intraplantar infiltration at intended surgical site

rat_2020.model: adult male Sprague–Dawley rats250–300g;plantar skin/fascia incision with longitudinal flexor digitorum brevis injury
rat_2020.sham: anesthesia without incision for transcript comparison
rat_2020.blinding: behavioral assessor blinded but authors report limited blinding due to distinct heat-response effect

behavior.baseline: heat/mechanical measurements on three presurgical days
behavior.technical_measurements: four5-minute SFL observations summed perrat;three withdrawal trials averaged perrat;not independent biological units
behavior.statistical_method: two-way repeated-measures ANOVA with Bonferroni timepoint comparisons;mean±SD
behavior.positive: reduced spontaneous foot-lift duration and mechanical/heat hypersensitivity;earlyposthoc SFLfrequency star inFigure1
behavior.qualification: frequency overallP=.059 is not significant at statedalpha.05 despite blanket prose;printed degrees of freedom not reconstructed
behavior.persistence: paper describes incision symptoms3–9days;heat withdrawal remains abovebaseline for severaldays aftercapsaicin;curves converge nearbaseline byday16
behavior.recovery_limit: graph-level behavioral follow-up,not equivalence or reinnervation proof

histology.reported_positive: loss of epidermal/dermal nervefibers in local sampled skin;authors call complete denervation
histology.measurement_scope: representative images,not quantified whole-paw fiber-count estimate
histology.other_observations: Merkelcells and dermalvessels appear unchanged inimages

RNA.independence_limit: ganglionlevels do not constitute independent animals;cell-type-specific signal unassigned
RNA.normalization: edgeR pipeline stated;no raw count matrix or gene-level q-values recovered

Bub1b.magnitude_limit: do not exponentiate or relabel3.42-fold because column convention conflicts with prose IFIT1B50-fold interpretation

RNA.global_response_conflict: Figure2B labels Inci/Cntl and(Inci+Cap)/Cntl with99overlap and25/1unique;setlabels/counts do not establish99reversals;cannot assignBub1b response
RNA.pathway_limit: IPA-predicted mitosis,mortality,tissuesize,IGF/TLR9/IL10RA are not measured regeneration/survival or causal mediation

mouse_2021_access_bounded.positive_in_abstract: reduced spontaneous/mechanical/heat pain-like behavior and sensoryfiberlength,with attenuatedcalciumresponses
mouse_2021_access_bounded.interpretation: supports distinct noncancer local-analgesia/defunctionalization lead;not equivalent to1%rat regimen

mechanism_and_competition.measured_positive_scope: local analgesicbehavior in noncancer incisionmodel with sensorydenervation
mechanism_and_competition.TRPV1: nociceptor mechanism distinct fromBUBR1;ratstudy hasno receptorKO/antagonistselectivitytest
mechanism_and_competition.comparison: Preserve symptom-specific benefit fairly. A pain benefit need not restoreBUBR1,but this local sensory target differs frommuscleoutput/renewal;provisionalniacin/apitegromab also lackMVAefficacy. No dietary or general regenerative claim.
